diff --git a/config/syslog/syslogconf.go b/config/syslog/syslogconf.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..de26d0f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/syslog/syslogconf.go
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+//go:build !windows
+
+package syslog
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"log/syslog"
+
+	"github.com/asaskevich/govalidator"
+	"golang.org/x/xerrors"
+)
+
+// Validate validates configuration
+func (c *Conf) Validate() (errs []error) {
+	if !c.Enabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+	//  If protocol is empty, it will connect to the local syslog server.
+	if len(c.Protocol) > 0 && c.Protocol != "tcp" && c.Protocol != "udp" {
+		errs = append(errs, errors.New(`syslog.protocol must be "tcp" or "udp"`))
+	}
+
+	// Default port: 514
+	if c.Port == "" {
+		c.Port = "514"
+	}
+
+	if _, err := c.GetSeverity(); err != nil {
+		errs = append(errs, err)
+	}
+
+	if _, err := c.GetFacility(); err != nil {
+		errs = append(errs, err)
+	}
+
+	if _, err := govalidator.ValidateStruct(c); err != nil {
+		errs = append(errs, err)
+	}
+	return errs
+}
+
+// GetSeverity gets severity
+func (c *Conf) GetSeverity() (syslog.Priority, error) {
+	if c.Severity == "" {
+		return syslog.LOG_INFO, nil
+	}
+
+	switch c.Severity {
+	case "emerg":
+		return syslog.LOG_EMERG, nil
+	case "alert":
+		return syslog.LOG_ALERT, nil
+	case "crit":
+		return syslog.LOG_CRIT, nil
+	case "err":
+		return syslog.LOG_ERR, nil
+	case "warning":
+		return syslog.LOG_WARNING, nil
+	case "notice":
+		return syslog.LOG_NOTICE, nil
+	case "info":
+		return syslog.LOG_INFO, nil
+	case "debug":
+		return syslog.LOG_DEBUG, nil
+	default:
+		return -1, xerrors.Errorf("Invalid severity: %s", c.Severity)
+	}
+}
+
+// GetFacility gets facility
+func (c *Conf) GetFacility() (syslog.Priority, error) {
+	if c.Facility == "" {
+		return syslog.LOG_AUTH, nil
+	}
+
+	switch c.Facility {
+	case "kern":
+		return syslog.LOG_KERN, nil
+	case "user":
+		return syslog.LOG_USER, nil
+	case "mail":
+		return syslog.LOG_MAIL, nil
+	case "daemon":
+		return syslog.LOG_DAEMON, nil
+	case "auth":
+		return syslog.LOG_AUTH, nil
+	case "syslog":
+		return syslog.LOG_SYSLOG, nil
+	case "lpr":
+		return syslog.LOG_LPR, nil
+	case "news":
+		return syslog.LOG_NEWS, nil
+	case "uucp":
+		return syslog.LOG_UUCP, nil
+	case "cron":
+		return syslog.LOG_CRON, nil
+	case "authpriv":
+		return syslog.LOG_AUTHPRIV, nil
+	case "ftp":
+		return syslog.LOG_FTP, nil
+	case "local0":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL0, nil
+	case "local1":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL1, nil
+	case "local2":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL2, nil
+	case "local3":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL3, nil
+	case "local4":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL4, nil
+	case "local5":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL5, nil
+	case "local6":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL6, nil
+	case "local7":
+		return syslog.LOG_LOCAL7, nil
+	default:
+		return -1, xerrors.Errorf("Invalid facility: %s", c.Facility)
+	}
+}
diff --git a/config/syslog/syslogconf_test.go b/config/syslog/syslogconf_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ed5146f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/syslog/syslogconf_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+//go:build !windows
+
+package syslog_test
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config/syslog"
+)
+
+func TestValidate(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		conf syslog.Conf
+		want int
+	}{
+		{"defaults", syslog.Conf{Enabled: true}, 0},
+		{"tcp", syslog.Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "tcp", Port: "5140"}, 0},
+		{"udp", syslog.Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "udp", Port: "12345", Severity: "emerg", Facility: "user"}, 0},
+		{"protocol", syslog.Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "foo", Port: "514"}, 1},
+		{"protocol and port", syslog.Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "invalid", Port: "-1"}, 2},
+		{"all core fields", syslog.Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "invalid", Port: "invalid", Severity: "invalid", Facility: "invalid"}, 4},
+		{"disabled", syslog.Conf{Protocol: "invalid", Port: "invalid", Severity: "invalid", Facility: "invalid"}, 0},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			if errs := tt.conf.Validate(); len(errs) != tt.want {
+				t.Errorf("Validate() returned %d errors, want %d: %v", len(errs), tt.want, errs)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+
+package syslog
+
+import "golang.org/x/xerrors"
+
+// Validate rejects syslog reporting on Windows.
+func (c *Conf) Validate() []error {
+	if !c.Enabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return []error{xerrors.New("windows not support syslog")}
+}
diff --git a/config/syslog/syslogconf_windows_test.go b/config/syslog/syslogconf_windows_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..67eb4cb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/syslog/syslogconf_windows_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+//go:build windows
+
+package syslog_test
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config/syslog"
+)
+
+func TestValidate(t *testing.T) {
+	if errs := (&syslog.Conf{}).Validate(); errs != nil {
+		t.Errorf("disabled syslog returned %v, want nil", errs)
+	}
+	err := (&syslog.Conf{Enabled: true}).Validate()
+	if len(err) != 1 || err[0].Error() != "windows not support syslog" {
+		t.Errorf("enabled syslog returned %v, want one Windows error", err)
+	}
+}

+package syslog
+
+// Conf is the syslog reporting configuration.
+type Conf struct {
+	Protocol string `json:"-"`
+	Host     string `valid:"host" json:"-"`
+	Port     string `valid:"port" json:"-"`
+	Severity string `json:"-"`
+	Facility string `json:"-"`
+	Tag      string `json:"-"`
+	Verbose  bool   `json:"-"`
+	Enabled  bool   `toml:"-" json:"-"`
+}
